runs.question: While shopping for a household consumer good, a person's income changes from 409.58 to 275.55. During the same period, the quantity purchased changes from 86.57 to 71.25. What is the income elasticity of demand for this good?

After a change in earnings, a person adjusts how often a preventive medical service is used. Their income changes from 248.32 to 470.71, and the quantity demanded of the medical service changes from 66.17 to 83.16. What is the income elasticity of demand for this medical service?

In a financial setting, an individual's annual income changes from 352.67 to 403.24. Over the same period, the quantity demanded of a savings-related financial product changes from 38.68 to 97.22. What is the income elasticity of demand for this financial product?

As household income changes from 117.52 to 161.72, the number of paid tutoring sessions chosen in an educational setting changes from 69.89 to 75.75. What is the income elasticity of demand for the tutoring sessions?

In a technology-focused household, monthly income changes from 290.28 to 190.76. During the same period, the quantity demanded of a personal device changes from 68.63 units to 46.53 units. What is the income elasticity of demand for this technology good?

After receiving a change in earnings, an individual adjusts spending on entertainment and changes the number of streaming subscriptions purchased. If income changes from 254.99 to 215.33 and the quantity of subscriptions demanded changes from 69.84 to 18.28, what is the income elasticity of demand for this entertainment service?

After a change in earnings from 382.07 to 412.29, the amount of a household eco-labeled product purchased as part of a sustainability program changes from 48.6 to 59.03. What is the income elasticity of demand for this environmental-policy-related good?

During an election season, an individual's income changes from 406.0 to 353.89. Over the same period, the quantity demanded of campaign merchandise changes from 57.59 to 58.12. What is the income elasticity of demand for campaign merchandise?

As income changes from 263.41 to 441.36, spending priorities shift in a sports-related setting, and the quantity demanded of a particular sporting good changes from 27.22 to 10.54. What is the income elasticity of demand for this sporting good?

After receiving a change in earnings, an individual adjusts participation in a gambling activity. Income changes from 365.73 to 262.55, while the quantity demanded of lottery tickets changes from 82.33 to 20.86. What is the income elasticity of demand for lottery tickets?
